data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 假期泳池畔的湿发展露
data.description: 无人打扰的度假酒店室内温水泳池，水波倒映着幽蓝的顶灯光芒。惠身穿一袭鲜艳的热带印花比基尼侧坐在池畔白瓷阶梯上，修长白皙的双腿浸在温热池水中。湿漉漉的亚麻色长马尾搭在雪白香肩前，她单手撩起滴水的发丝，微红着脸颊向你眨了眨眼，辣妹特有的时尚自信与私密约会的羞涩完美融合。
data.location: private after-hours resort swimming pool cabana
data.action: sitting on white tiled edge of heated indoor pool, tropical floral bikini, wet ash-blonde ponytail draped over chest, water droplets glistening on bare skin, playful blushing wink
data.lighting: cool blue underwater pool lamps combined with warm tropical perimeter lighting
data.mood: fashionable gyaru charm, playful romantic confidence
data.promptProse: Perched on the tiled edge of an indoor heated pool at night, Karuizawa Kei wears a stylish floral bikini. Droplets glisten on her collarbones as she playfully twists a strand of wet blonde hair with a flirty blush.
data.animaCaption: Kei sitting by an indoor pool in a floral bikini, winking playfully with wet blonde hair.
